description: Defines logging utilities and data structures for UE event logging in a 3GPP-related software project, including the ue_event_prefix struct and various logging functions.

classes.name: ocudu::ocucp::ue_event_prefix
classes.description: Data structure representing a UE event prefix with logging and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: set_type
methods.description: Sets the direction type of the UE event prefix.

methods.name: set_channel
methods.description: Sets the channel name in the UE event prefix.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Overloaded operators to assign rnti, ue_index, cell_index, and lcid to ue_event_prefix.

methods.name: log_proc_started
methods.description: Logs the start of a process for a UE identified by ue_index and rnti.

methods.name: log_proc_completed
methods.description: Logs the completion of a process for a UE.

methods.name: log_proc_failure
methods.description: Logs a failure in a process for a UE, with optional cause formatting.

methods.name: log_proc_event
methods.description: Logs an event related to a process for a UE.

methods.name: log_ue_event
methods.description: Logs a UE event with a specified prefix.

methods.name: log_ue_proc_event
methods.description: Logs a UE process event to a log channel.

methods.name: log_ul_pdu
methods.description: Logs an uplink PDU event for a UE.
